alt: Image.
nearby_text: The work issue / People & practice Better work starts with a conversation. What two people and a shared screen can teach us about finding a way forward. By the Common Ground editorial team · 6 minute read A collaborative working session. There is a moment in a good conversation when a difficult problem starts to feel possible. Someone points to a detail. Someone else asks a question. The shape of the work changes. Make the thinking visible. Shared notes, simple sketches, and a screen everyone can see give a team something concrete to discuss. The next step becomes easier to agree on. Leave enough space for a different point of view.
